result.summary: Rework-1 partial improvement: sbx03_03 regression fixed (17/17 in sbx01_02_03 binary), sbx04_02 now passes. Still 12/17 failing in test_sbx04_06 binary. Root cause: insertTaskSpec helper at test_sbx04_06.zig:150 uses tenant_id column in INSERT but task_specs table has no tenant_id (per-tenant schema, isolation via search_path). Fix in bcc0f902 was incomplete — removed tenant_id from handler SELECT but not from test helper INSERT.

issues.title: insertTaskSpec helper uses tenant_id column that does not exist in task_specs
issues.description: tests/integration/test_sbx04_06.zig insertTaskSpec() at line 150 uses tenant_id in INSERT. task_specs (migration 1170) is scope=tenant_only with no tenant_id column. Fix: change INSERT INTO task_specs (orchestrator_principal, spec_hash, spec_body, tenant_id) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, current_setting('app.current_tenant_id')::uuid) to INSERT INTO task_specs (orchestrator_principal, spec_hash, spec_body) VALUES ($1, $2, $3). Blocks 12 tests.

result.next_action: ORCH must spawn ADHOC BACKEND-DEV to fix insertTaskSpec helper (remove tenant_id from INSERT), then redispatch TEST-RUNNER for rework-2.
